implementation: Standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with local font and lens-texture assets; opens directly as a local file or through any static server.

actual_work_limits.scope: navigation, hero, pointer lens approximation, cookie dismissal, desktop and mobile

verified.pointer_check: After moving pointer to 300,250 and waiting 350ms, the 250px lens bounding box was approximately x=179.36 y=127.08; center approximately 304.36,252.08.

missing_features_and_limitations: The pointer lens follows pointer/touch input with easing and shows chromatically offset Japanese text, but does not reproduce the original shader refraction, displacement, or spatially accurate translation reveal.
Background is a hand-authored canvas approximation with noise. It is static; original animated fluid behavior was not available in the supplied still reference and is not implemented.
Only a desktop reference was supplied. Mobile layout is inferred and tested for rendering/menu/cookie behavior, not matched against an original mobile reference.
The hero sentence was inferred from partially obscured screenshot text; the DOM manifest did not include its canvas-rendered copy.
Navigation destinations are conventional external monopo URLs inferred from labels. Their destination correctness was not verified; no local secondary routes were built.
Clock labels reproduce the reference snapshot and do not update.
Recent work and lower-page content are outside this control's requested hero/navigation scope and are not reconstructed.
Cookie persistence initially failed because author display:flex overrode hidden; corrected and rechecked successfully.
Visual differences remain in background contours, lens typography/refraction, wordmark, and responsive composition. No pixel-perfect or original-dynamic-equivalence claim is made.
